The guide's machine relationships (remote delegation over SSH, credentials, where execution and records live) do not depend on request titles. Prose accurate.

Merge review (origin/main 74c2f4f31 into #2915/#2916): both sides changed this record. Main's #2920 (C2b) forwards station-control remote-Station calls through one RemoteStationForwarder, refuses a saved Environment on the delegation listing/options routes for non-operator station-control callers, and guards SDK body reads with the request deadline; this branch adds approvalModeAuthority to the command route's respondToRequest and the Claude session-grant rules. Main corrected its See-also for the delegation caller; the guide makes no claim about answering engine requests. Prose accurate.
